notes: Fixes the real reason quitting and other fixes were not sticking, plus a real icon and a proper installer.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.8

sections.title: The update process itself
items: Found and fixed why some earlier fixes did not seem to take. A leftover process from before could block the update from replacing the app's main file, even though the update looked successful. That block is gone now.
Quitting the app fully closes it, and nothing gets left running.

sections.title: Look and feel
items: ELLA Zero has a real icon now, on the desktop, in the taskbar, and everywhere else.
The installer itself is redesigned. No more generic setup wizard.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
